scope: The reconstructed cathedral on the plaza in San Ignacio de Velasco, Bolivia, with the wide tiled nave roof, plaza veranda, painted facade, flanking timber galleries and stairs, bell tower and mapped rear attachment as represented in September 2022.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The municipal council identifies the 1761 cathedral and its modern replacements.
The municipal tourism assessment describes the three naves, large timber columns and 1998–2001 reconstruction from historic photographs.
